name: cost-guard
description: Alerts and hard stops on Claude Code spend per session and per day, plus a warning before resuming an idle session whose prompt cache expired. No admin rights needed.

session_cap_usd.title: Session cap (USD)
session_cap_usd.description: Hard stop for one session: new prompts are blocked and tool calls are denied.

daily_cap_usd.title: Daily cap (USD)
daily_cap_usd.description: Hard stop for all sessions on this machine in one calendar day.

warn_at_usd.title: Alert at (USD)
warn_at_usd.description: Comma-separated session amounts that show a one-time alert without blocking, for example 10,25,50.

cold_cache_warn_usd.title: Cold-cache warning (USD)
cold_cache_warn_usd.description: Stop once when resuming an idle session would cost more than this just to re-cache its context.

override_word.title: Override word
override_word.description: Put this word in a message to continue past a stop.
